a11yMenu.buttonActive: Accessibility settings ({count, plural, one {# active} other {# active}})
a11yMenu.title: Accessibility
a11yMenu.intro: All off by default. Your choice is saved in this browser.
a11yMenu.zoomHint: To enlarge text, use your browser's zoom (press Ctrl and +, or ⌘ and + on a Mac).

contrast.label: Higher contrast
contrast.description: Lighter secondary text, stronger borders and separators, readable placeholder text.

focus.label: Highly visible focus
focus.description: A thick ring around the element reached with the keyboard.

links.label: Underlined links
links.description: All text links are underlined, not just colored.

font.label: Simplified font
font.description: A single sans-serif font, with no forced capitals or letter spacing.

spacing.label: Text spacing
spacing.description: More room between lines, words, letters and paragraphs.

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.description: Stops decorative animations and transitions, even if your system doesn't ask for it.
